question.problem: Given an arithmetic sequence that has ${a}_{8}=8$ and the common difference $d=4$, what is the general formula for the $n$th term of the sequence?

current_example.problem: Find the formula for the $n$th term of the arithmetic sequence that has a $7$th term equal to $-34$ and a common difference of $-5.$
current_example.worked_solution:
First, notice that $a_{7}=-34$ is $6$ jumps after $a_1$.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14204090/assets/ea803977d4861ad654bd29ff15f706fdd1d11f71dbf7c885f175fe8168f21b66.png)

Hence, we can write

$$
a_{7} = a_1 + 6d,
$$

and solve for $a_1$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{7} & ={a}_{1}+6d \\ -34 & ={a}_{1}+6(-5) \\ -34 & ={a}_{1}-30 \\ -4 & ={a}_{1}\end{aligned}
$$

So, the formula for the $n$th term is

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & ={a}_{1}+(n-1)d \\  & =-4+(n-1)(-5) \\  & =-4-5n+5 \\  & =1-5n.\end{aligned}
$$
